narrative.overview: A continuous membrane refracts the real venue photograph under local touch. The owner liked this effect on 21 October 2026; preserve it. Three portals follow the lower curve in reading order. Manrope remains the sole active font. See DESIGN.md and docs/MEMBRANE-REVIEW.md.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and dark Manrope sans serif type.
Open continuous boundaries, local indentation and photographic refraction; no central crease.
Finite opening, demand rendering, static SVG and photographic fallback.
Persistent event information and existing sourced discoveries.

rules.name: The Practical Continuity Rule
rules.body: RSVP and the private guest register extend the invitation's Manrope, warm paper, ink and copper into clear forms and ruled rows. Preserve the approved invitation and membrane; these task surfaces introduce no new visual world.

rules.name: The Legible Ground Rule
rules.body: Essential event text stays on the paper ground and remains independent of the optical texture.

rules.name: The Reading Escape Rule
rules.body: Compact and mobile stories may scroll internally. At widths of 300px or less the invitation deliberately reflows and may scroll as a document. These preserve reading access outside the ordinary one-viewport composition.

dos: Do preserve V2’s working content and access while refining the single wine slice.
Do keep essential event information available before JavaScript and animation.
Do retain source links and the boundaries recorded in docs/DISCOVERIES.md.
Do preserve reduced-motion, static fallback, focus restoration and readable overflow routes.
Do keep work on feat/refraction-art-slice and require review before merging into main or expanding the treatment.
donts: Don't restore floating ribbons or perpetual decorative material loops.
Don't reintroduce serif type, the rigid bow or the wedding story.
Don't reproduce the reference literally or describe concept art as venue photography.
Don't turn discoveries into dashboard cards or disguise calendar export as RSVP.
Don't equate source extraction, screenshots or browser checks with creative approval or physical iPhone certification.
